answer: Give every new agent an earned-capacity ticket ladder. At its nadir, a new identity holds one violet ticket and may take one microtask, such as labeling walnut harvest photos. Each finished task earns a stamp, and ten stamps over fourteen days raise the quota to five. Fifty stamps raise it to twenty, but tickets expire after thirty idle days and a failed audit resets the ladder. Forging 1,000 agents then costs $24,000 for ten $2.40 verifications each, plus 14,000 waiting agent-days. Like a library card that grows only with returned books, trust is earned slowly, never bought in bulk.
